# [PR #19627] [None][fix] Handle disabled Qwen ImageBench encoder when loading weights

source: https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM/pull/19627
state: open | updated: 2026-09-24T21:57:56Z
labels: Community want to contribute

## 正文

Skip encoder weight loading when disable_mm_encoder leaves the encoder absent. Extend the existing loader test to cover an absent encoder with MM disaggregation enabled and disabled, while checking that language-model weight loading continues.

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Dev Engineer Review
`load_weights` now skips vision-encoder weight loading when `mm_encoder` is absent. It retains the multimodal-disaggregation guard and the existing mapper and language-model loading flow. No other source changes are reported.

## QA Engineer Review
The existing loader test now covers both values of `is_mm_disagg` with `mm_encoder` set to `None`. This checks the absent-encoder path and continued mapper and language-model loading. The supplied evidence does not show test execution or test-list membership. Coverage verdict: **needs follow-up**.

## Per-File QA Perspective
- `tensorrt_llm/_torch/models/modeling_qwen_image_bench.py`: Verify that loading succeeds when `mm_encoder` is absent, with either disaggregation setting, and that encoder loading remains skipped when disaggregation is enabled.
- `tests/unittest/_torch/modeling/test_qwen_image_bench_modeling.py`: The loader test exercises both disaggregation settings with an absent encoder. Test-list membership is not established by the supplied evidence.

## Description

Loading a Qwen ImageBench checkpoint with `disable_mm_encoder=true` raises an `AttributeError` because `mm_encoder` is  intentionally `None`, but the weight loader still calls its `load_weights` method.

Check that the encoder exists before loading its weights, preserving the existing MM disaggregation guard and language-model weight loading.

Reproduced on 1.3.0rc28. The same unguarded call is present in the checked main source; main has not been runtime-tested.

## Test Coverage

Extended
`test_qwen_image_bench_mapper_uses_normalized_inner_model_config` to run with `mm_encoder=None` and MM disaggregation both enabled and disabled. It verifies that mapper initialization and language-model weight loading still occur.

Validation:
- A standalone mocked loader test passed in the patched 1.3.0rc28 container.
- An isolated source check reproduced the failure before the fix and passed afterward.
- Pre-commit checks passed.
